name: saathi
description: Voice-first assistant that helps seniors fill a bank savings-account form in Hindi, Kannada or English.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta -k --handle-input "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.check: npm run check --prefix server && npm run check --prefix web
